answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Salt pan builder brine barrel seal countersigned by the drying yard is the proof, and the price is each brine barrel is a measured salt yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. A farm either pays 74005 POA up front or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool. The reef is checked once, the copper is charged once, and the wharf is read every epoch after. The record is public, the price is fixed, and the farm cannot negotiate either.
